title: Cloudhop Meadows
tagline: Hop, dash and bloom your way up the candy-coloured sky islands!
pitch: Cloudhop Meadows: a bright, juicy 3D platformer across floating sky islands. Run, double-jump and dash between candy-coloured islands and wobbly mushroom platforms, collect glowing star seeds, dodge spinning thorn bars, and reach the giant blooming flower portal at the top. Cheerful music, a bouncy HUD with a seed counter and timer.
controls: Space: jump, press again mid-air for double jump

plan.title: Cloudhop Meadows
plan.tagline: Hop, dash and bloom your way up the candy-coloured sky islands!
plan.core_loop: Run, double-jump and dash between floating sky islands, grabbing glowing star seeds and dodging spinning thorn bars, climbing tier by tier until you reach the giant blooming flower portal at the top.
controls: Space: jump, press again mid-air for double jump
plan.win_condition: Collect at least 25 of the 40 star seeds and reach the blooming flower portal at the top before the 180-second timer runs out.
plan.lose_condition: Lose all 3 lives (thorn-bar hits or falling into the void) or let the timer hit zero.
plan.art_direction: Candy-box world in bright noon light: pastel mint grass, bubblegum-pink and butter-yellow floating islands, glossy toon shading with soft ink outlines, cotton-candy clouds drifting far below, and warm rim light on every rounded edge. Everything is round, bouncy and readable at a glance — Crash Bandicoot's floating isles meets a sugar shop, with cheerful saturation and zero gloom.
concept_shots: The chibi player mid-double-jump between two pastel islands, a trail of glowing star seeds arcing overhead, fluffy clouds far below and sun glinting on the rim light.
The player dashing across a wobbly mushroom cap as a thorn bar spins overhead, dust puff and speed lines trailing behind, camera tilted with a light shake.
The summit: the giant flower portal's petals bloom open in a confetti burst as the player lands, the bouncy HUD showing 25/25 Star Seeds and the final time.

assets.sky: Bright midday sky panorama: soft cyan-to-warm-cream gradient, big cotton-candy cumulus clouds, a few distant floating islands with tiny waterfalls, soft sun glint in the upper left.

assets.music: Cheerful chiptune-pop loop, 122 BPM, major key: bouncy ukulele strums, bright marimba lead, plucky synth stabs, handclaps and a playful whistle melody — light, upbeat and bouncy.

sfx.prompt: Bright ascending two-note chime with a tiny sparkle shimmer, like picking up a candy star
Short bouncy boing with a rising pitch, soft and playful
Soft squishy thud with a tiny dust puff, low and round
Comedic bonk: descending muffled thump with a wobble
Quick airy whoosh with a rising zip for the dash
Triumphant little fanfare: rising arpeggio, sparkle cymbals and a happy chord hit

features: Spinning thorn-bar hazards (spinner) on the main route to dodge or get bonked by
Wobbly swaying mushroom platforms as movers between island tiers
Spring bounce pads on mushroom caps that launch the player to the next tier
Dash with dust puff and speed lines, double-jump with a sparkle ring
Checkpoint flags at each island tier with a chime and ring FX
Void below the islands: falling respawns you at the last checkpoint with a poof

result.summary:
Cloudhop Meadows: a bright toon 3D platformer across floating candy sky islands. The player (bubblegum-pink chibi with butter-yellow accent) runs, double-jumps and dashes up a large sky_islands level, collecting 25 of 40 star seeds, dodging spinning thorn bars, bouncing off spring pads, and reaching the golden bloom portal before a 180-second timer runs out, with 3 lives.

Built on top of the scaffold:
- Level: large sky_islands (seed 7), all 40 collectibles retagged to 'star'.
- Dressing: generated candy_mushroom and glow_flower props placed every other route point (with World.heightAt sanity check so they only land on the correct island surface), plus 4 spring_pad props paired with Gameplay bounce hazards on route points 4/10/16/22 to help the climb, and 5 spinner thorn-bar hazards on route points 3/8/13/19/25.
- Player: platformer with the plan's body/accent colours, runSpeed 13, jumpHeight 4.5.
- Rules: collect {star, target 25}, goal true (portal locked until 25 stars), timer 180s, lives 3, 4 enemies spread along the route. onWin fires a big multi-colour confetti burst; onLose poofs the player.
- HUD (arcade style): star-seed counter using the generated icon_star_seed icon with target 25, timer, 3 hearts, minimap, objective line, custom win/lose screen titles.
- Title screen with the plan's tagline, "Press Space to hop", controls credit, and a 3-2-1-GO countdown.
- FX: FX.auto for base juice, plus custom moments — +10 text on star collect, checkpoint toast with flag icon, "need N more seeds" toast on goalLocked, "the bloom is open" toast + starBurst on goalOpen, speed lines on dash, sparkle ring on double jump, slow-mo on death, white poof on respawn.
- Audio: Audio.auto + music_main (arcade procedural fallback if the mp3 is missing).
- Debug.install + game.start() as required.

Verified with play_game: zero console errors, autopilot moves along the route and collects stars (4 in 10s, more in 20s), HUD/counter/timer/lives/minimap all render correctly, generated sky panorama loads, and the toon_bright look matches the candy-meadow art direction.
changes: Retagged all 40 level collectibles to 'star' (the plan's pickup)
Placed generated candy_mushroom and glow_flower props along the route with heightAt sanity checks
Added 4 spring_pad props + 4 bounce hazards on route points to aid the climb
Added 5 spinner thorn-bar hazards on the main route
Customised player colours (body #ff6f91, accent #ffd93d) and tuning (runSpeed 13, jumpHeight 4.5)
Configured Gameplay.rules: collect star target 25, goal true, timer 180, lives 3, 4 enemies, onWin confetti + onLose poof
HUD: arcade style, star-seed counter with generated icon + target 25, timer, lives, minimap, objective, custom win/lose screen titles
Title screen with tagline, 'Press Space to hop', controls credit, 3-2-1-GO countdown
Extra FX moments: +10 text on collect, checkpoint/goalLocked/goalOpen toasts, dash speed lines, double-jump ring, death slow-mo, respawn poof
Audio: Audio.auto + music_main with arcade procedural fallback
known_issues: Autopilot occasionally dies to spinners or falls off islands (2 deaths in a 20s run) — expected for a hazard-laden platformer; checkpoints respawn it
The generated candy_mushroom/glow_flower props use a procedural fallback (mushroom/tree) when the voxel data is not in the manifest; they still read as candy dressing

The level's default island palette is grass-green rather than the pastel mint/bubblegum described in the art direction — the kit's toon_bright palette drives island colours and there is no per-island colour override exposed in the Level docs

operator_interventions: operator re-ran the asset stage for the sound effects and props that had failed (--backfill-assets) after the sfx-length and Idol-token fixes
